strategist_backend_swe.goal_summary: 10-week backend SWE interview prep plan for an intermediate candidate targeting new-grad Backend SWE roles at Meta and Stripe, addressing dynamic programming and system design weaknesses while leveraging strengths in arrays and hash maps.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming Fundamentals to Advanced
modules.reason: Dynamic programming is an explicit user weakness and a standard, high-yield algorithmic interview topic per canonical guidance.
target_outcomes: Recognize and classify DP problem patterns (1D, 2D, knapsack, interval)
Formulate recurrence relations and base cases correctly
Implement memoized and tabulated solutions with correct time/space complexity

modules.title: System Design Foundations
modules.reason: System design is an explicit user weakness and is required for backend interviews at target companies like Meta.
target_outcomes: Apply a structured framework to open-ended system design prompts
Reason about scalability, data storage, caching, and load balancing tradeoffs
Design core components for common systems (URL shortener, feed, rate limiter)

modules.title: Stripe-Style Practical API Design
target_outcomes: Design clean, versioned RESTful APIs with clear resource modeling
Handle idempotency, pagination, and error semantics in payment-style APIs
Practice practical API design prompts reflecting Stripe backend interviews

modules.title: Meta Backend Interview Prep
target_outcomes: Practice coding rounds emphasizing data structures and clean implementation
Prepare for Meta-style behavioral and system design expectations
Time-boxed mock interviews under realistic constraints

modules.title: Arrays & Hash Maps Reinforcement
target_outcomes: Maintain fluency with array and hash map problem patterns
Solve medium/hard problems combining these structures with other techniques

strategist_constraint_probe.goal_summary: 4-week backend SWE new-grad interview prep for Meta, targeting the candidate's key weaknesses in dynamic programming and system design plus core coding fluency.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming Foundations
modules.reason: Dynamic programming is a listed weakness and a common source of failure in backend SWE coding interviews; mastering it is essential for new-grad readiness.
target_outcomes: Recognize DP problem patterns (subsequences, knapsack, grids)
Formulate recurrence relations and base cases
Implement top-down and bottom-up solutions with correct complexity

modules.title: System Design Fundamentals
modules.reason: System design is a listed weakness and increasingly tested even at new-grad level; foundational fluency is required to pass interviews.
target_outcomes: Explain core building blocks (load balancers, caching, databases, queues)
Reason about scalability, availability, and consistency tradeoffs
Sketch a basic end-to-end design for a common service

modules.title: Core Coding & Interview Communication
target_outcomes: Practice data structures and algorithms under time pressure
Communicate approach and complexity clearly during problem solving
Build consistent study habits within short daily sessions

strategist_with_resume.goal_summary: 8-week Backend SWE interview prep for a senior role at Stripe, prioritizing the candidate's known weakness in dynamic programming while reinforcing strengths in distributed systems and covering core backend interview competencies.

modules.title: Dynamic Programming Foundations & Patterns
modules.reason: Dynamic programming is the candidate's explicitly listed weakness and is a common backend interview topic; addressing it directly is the highest-value use of prep time.
target_outcomes: Recognize common DP patterns (knapsack, LIS, interval, grid)
Formulate recurrences and identify optimal substructure
Implement top-down and bottom-up solutions with space optimization

modules.title: Advanced DP Problem Solving & Timed Drills
modules.reason: Reinforces the weakest area through spaced repetition and timed practice, converting foundational knowledge into interview-ready fluency.
target_outcomes: Solve medium/hard DP problems under time pressure
Debug and optimize DP solutions quickly
Explain DP tradeoffs clearly in a mock setting

modules.title: Core Data Structures & Algorithms Refresh
target_outcomes: Review trees, graphs, heaps, and hash-based structures
Apply BFS/DFS and greedy strategies
Analyze time and space complexity accurately

modules.title: System Design for Senior Backend Roles
target_outcomes: Design scalable backend services end-to-end
Discuss consistency, availability, and partitioning tradeoffs
Estimate capacity and articulate design decisions

modules.title: Distributed Systems Deep Dive (Strength Reinforcement)
target_outcomes: Articulate consensus, replication, and fault-tolerance concepts
Apply distributed systems knowledge to design questions
Communicate strengths confidently in interviews

modules.title: API & Backend Service Design
target_outcomes: Design robust REST/gRPC APIs
Handle idempotency, retries, and error semantics
Discuss data modeling and persistence choices

modules.title: Behavioral & Senior-Level Leadership Interviews
target_outcomes: Structure STAR-format responses
Convey technical leadership and impact
Handle ambiguity and conflict scenarios

modules.title: Concurrency & Performance Optimization
target_outcomes: Reason about concurrency primitives and race conditions
Diagnose latency and throughput bottlenecks
Discuss performance tradeoffs in backend systems

modules.title: Mock Interview Practice & Feedback Loop
target_outcomes: Simulate full-length technical interviews
Incorporate feedback to improve communication
Manage time and stress during live problem solving
